intent: Adjusted sensor positions to extend coverage to tape edges while maintaining larger sensor size and wider wheel track/body width for stability. Expect reduced line loss events and improved performance on slalom track, with better line detection and turning stability.
rationale: The previous iteration increased sensor size to 0.016 m and widened the wheel track and body width to 0.16 m, which improved stability and off-track tolerance but the robot still failed to complete the slalom track, with off-track terminations and line loss events. Telemetry shows line loss mainly at tape edges, suggesting sensor coverage at edges can be improved. To address this, I propose adjusting sensor positions to extend coverage further to the left and right edges of the tape, while keeping the 5-sensor layout and sensor size at 0.016 m. The wheel track and body width remain at 0.16 m to maintain stability. Wheel radius and body length remain unchanged to preserve speed and agility. I expect this adjustment to reduce line loss events on the slalom track, improve line detection at tape edges, and enhance overall completion and error metrics, especially on challenging tracks.
